whenToUse: Flows with fixed steps, such as checkout, sign-up, or applications.
There are three to five steps.
You want to tell people up front how many steps are left.
whenNotToUse: There are many steps or they change (use a progress bar).
Settings people move between in any order (use tabs).
A form that fits on one screen.

alternatives.name: Progress Bar
alternatives.reason: Showing a share instead of steps.

accessibility: Convey the order with an ol list, and mark the current step with aria-current="step".
Finished steps show a check and read visually hidden "(done)" text.
Numbers and connecting lines are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
Always show the step names as text.
